notes: This file uses ISO 3166-1 country/territory code elements for technical completeness. It includes sovereign countries plus dependent territories/special areas with ISO alpha-2 codes.
The original fields `name`, `code`, `capital`, `region`, `population`, and `currency` are preserved for app compatibility.
Use `currencies` and `timezones` for the richer data. Some countries/territories have more than one currency or timezone.
Population values are retained/fallback metadata only; population is not the authoritative focus of this file and should be refreshed separately if used for reporting.
Antarctica has no official ISO 4217 tender currency, so its currency field is null and currencies is an empty array.
Bouvet Island and Heard Island and McDonald Islands have no dedicated IANA timezone mapping in the source timezone dataset, so timezones is an empty array.
